bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 4, 5, 7, 8. CHECKS'N'BALANCES must be forgiven for an unplaced latest effort at Murwillumbah when he struck traffic problems on the day. He's suitably placed here with Ben Looker aboard for the first time. TOUCHATISM was resuming from a very long spell when she wasn't disgraced at her Gosford home base and she can only present race-fitter today. REGNIER was withdrawn from the Scone meeting held last Tuesday and instead she makes her debut today after trialing recently at Gosford. She can cope over this journey at her first start. BILLYBAGO has had his opportunities to open his account without doing so but he's raced well fresh in the past and he can do so again when he presents first up today.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 5, 6, 8. FLETCHER was attempting to lead throughout within this distance range when he found the opposition too strong at Hawkesbury last start. He will be far more suitably placed today when he competes in blinkers for the first time. LA BELLA ROSA performed above market place expectations at Grafton last start and she can be expected to maintain her form today when she makes her home track debut fifth up in her first campaign since a stable change. RIPS LAW wasn't disgraced at Moree and he can cope with an awaiting distance rise today with a gear change made (blinkers off). RONARDO concedes race-day experience to all when he makes his debut today but blinkers are already a part of his gear and this class suits after two provincial trials since a spell. BON BATAN should relish an awaiting distance rise today after a latest unplaced Port Macquarie efffort which can be overlooked.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 4, 6. NARUKAMI led throughout after gear changes had been made last start at Port Macquarie with Liberty Smyth aboard. He can be expected to at least maintain his form today at only his second start since a stable change was made. SMOKEY SAINT refused to shirk his task in defeat after he struck early trouble at his Port Macquarie home base. He was produced after a thirty-two day break on the day and a quicker back-up now aids his cause. HOTZINO handed in a solid effort within this distance range at her Grafton home base last start and she's more than ready to make her Kempsey debut today. ENZONI had too much to do in this class at Port Macquarie and his unplaced effort must be ignored.

bestBets.overview: On pace runners, 1, 2, 7, 8. FLASH PRINCE wasn't disgraced at the Gold Coast when he was produced within this distance range last start and he's more suitably placed in this weaker class today. BELLA KATHLEEN is an experienced Port Macquarie based mare who will be making her Kempsey debut today. Her unplaced Taree effort five days ago was better than it appears on paper and a quick back-up can now be regarded as a plus. FARRAIGE handed in an honest effort in that same Taree race which was last contested by BELLA KATHLEEN and a repeat performance can allow him to figure prominently in the finish here.   STROBING has been in work for some time however, a drop in class and a rise in distance combine to aid his cause today.
